assumptions: The 10-node graph is one deterministic local fixture; exact enumeration is not a scaling or advantage claim.
HMAC-SHA256 is used only as a local test authentication tag, not as a provider digital signature or authorization.
A same-device identity and process replacement test do not establish kernel crash, flush, cache or power-loss durability.
The ZIP64 fixture parses metadata only and does not read archive payload bytes.
Covariance, cost, ranking, AI, custody and QOS values are synthetic; SCM is fiction-only.
